name: Can a door adjustment include drywall or trim repairs around the frame?

mainEntity.name: Can a door adjustment include drywall or trim repairs around the frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, door adjustments frequently reveal underlying issues like cracked drywall around the casing, loose studs, or deteriorated framing from past moisture. A full-service remodeling contractor handles the finish carpentry, framing, and drywall repairs in-house during the same service call. This eliminates the need to call separate drywallers or painters if trim must be pulled and walls patched to plumb the jamb. Having a general contractor on site ensures that if an exterior door frame has hidden framing rot or settling damage, the underlying structural support is properly restored.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, finish contractors can pull trim, shim framing, and patch surrounding drywall or paint in a single visit if jamb realignment is required.
